create_Calculator: create a Calculator instance for a 2-player open_spiel game to compute action values vs best response
run_Calculator_call: run the Calculator __call__ method to compute action values, exploitability, and reach probabilities for a player policy against a best responder
build_CalculatorReturn: build a _CalculatorReturn namedtuple containing exploitability, action values vs best response, and counterfactual reach probabilities
test__transitions: test the _transitions function to get (action, probability) pairs from a game state for chance nodes or player moves
test__tuples_from_policy: test the _tuples_from_policy function to convert a policy probability vector into a list of (action, probability) tuples
